claims.where: front matter: cost; rationale: cost; Why it matters
claims.claim: Cost is low, meaning indirect cost only, despite the published licence requirements and the discussion of buying premium learning functionality.
claims.quote:
cost: "low"
Cost rationale: 'a Microsoft Copilot licence is mandatory for full functionality and Viva Learning Premium unlocks advanced features'
Why it matters: 'whether Viva Learning Premium is worth buying for the advanced features'
claims.fix: Set cost to 'medium'. Replace its rationale with: 'Medium. Full functionality requires a Microsoft Copilot licence, and advanced learning features require Viva Learning Premium under the overview's Private Preview FAQ; additional licensing may therefore be needed for the selected users. A separate agent price or meter is not yet published.' This uses the verified FAQ at https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/learning/learning-agent-overview-deployment-steps and retains its preview qualification.
